title: The pullback of an invertible module is invertible
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes and $\mathcal L$ an invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], i.e. a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module such that every point of $Y$ has an open neighbourhood $V$ with $\mathcal L|_V\cong\mathcal O_V$. Then the pullback $f^*\mathcal L$ [def-pc-module-pullback] is an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module: for every open $V\subseteq Y$ with $\mathcal L|_V\cong\mathcal O_V$ one has $(f^*\mathcal L)|_{f^{-1}V}\cong\mathcal O_{f^{-1}V}$.
